requiredFindings.title: F8c pins the verifier bytes requiring VD2A-RF-01
requiredFindings.description: The present record passes its structural, accepted-parent, candidate-coverage and materialization checks. Acceptance is withheld because its subject carries the verifier bytes requiring correction; the resulting reference and re-pin artifacts must be refreshed and independently reviewed. This is the consequence of the single unit finding, not a separate record-structure defect.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Correcting the verifier changes the reference candidate, tool-only diff, closure and lane pins, registry digest, generated report headers, evidence and subject/record pins. Refresh F8c on the corrected bytes and rerun the requested checks before seeking acceptance of the coupled unit.
